table.name: people
table.purpose: Registry of individuals (Russian/Bulgarian volleyball players by the names) with their nationality, birth date and height; each person is referenced by a poker_player record.

col_001.name: person_id
col_001.description: Primary key, unique integer identifier for each person; referenced by poker_player.

col_003.name: full_name
col_003.description: Person's full name (first + last), unique per row.

col_004.name: birth_date
col_004.description: Birth date stored as formatted text ('Month DD, YYYY').

col_005.name: height_cm
col_005.description: Height in centimeters (values 182–207, consistent with volleyball players' heights).

table.name: poker_player
table.purpose: One row per poker player, holding their personal attributes (linked to the people table) and poker-specific stats such as earnings and final-table finishes.

col_001.name: poker_player_id
col_001.description: Primary key of the table; a unique sequential identifier for each poker player row.

col_002.name: people_id
col_002.description: Foreign key to people.col_001, identifying the person record for this player (one-to-one).

col_003.name: final_table_rank
col_003.description: A small unique integer per player (10-42). Plausibly the player's final ranking/position in a tournament or final table, but the evidence is weak; could also be an age or another identifier.

col_006.name: earnings
col_006.description: Large unique amounts (104,871 to 596,462), consistent with tournament prize money / career winnings in currency units.
